note: Set A covers more of the page's substantive engineering facts — substrate slope at 1/4" per foot, the thin-set/waterproof-membrane/subfloor build-up, white thinset adhesion of the glass tile, gypsum wallboard thickness, the detail scales, and the title-block/BOREALIS data — while Set B omits the slope and the membrane/adhesive layers entirely and repeats the 3/4" gable thickness three times plus the glass-tile dimensions and layout twice. Set B's main error is binding the 3" dimension to a shower pan 'curb width' (the dimension is the pan width, and no curb is labeled), stated twice. Set A's errors are the misbound 'P3 STEEL L-BRACKET' attachment (P3 is the gable finish, and the quote is a fabricated concatenation), calling WHITE THINSET MORTAR the backsplash material rather than its adhesive, and an invented 'direction E' condition on the slope. On balance A's broader correct coverage outweighs its three errors versus B's two errors and heavy redundancy.
